source_issue.title: Polish documentation renames, and overall shape

summary_markdown:
## What this issue is about
This issue focuses on polishing the documentation for the Plone project, specifically addressing renames and the structure of the "Contributing..." section. An earlier pull request has made significant updates, but further adjustments are needed to remove outdated references to Volto.

## What needs to be done
You will need to review the current documentation and refine the "Contributing..." section to ensure it is aligned with the current Plone guidelines. This might involve updating links, removing outdated information, and improving the overall layout.

## Helpful background
The discussion reveals some ambiguities regarding references to the Volto project and the Storybook link. It’s helpful to verify if certain sections still meet current needs. Engaging with existing documentation, including [First-time contributors](https://6.docs.plone.org/contributing/first-time.html), is encouraged.

## Good first steps
1. Review the current documentation at [Plone Aurora Docs](https://plone-aurora.readthedocs.io/).
2. Identify sections referring to Volto that need updates.
3. Make notes on any layout improvements.
4. Consider participating in discussions to clarify any uncertain points.
5. Once ready, open a PR with your changes for review.
